scope: Serialized independent USD asset acceptance; not runtime PhysX or physics parity

restitution_candidate.derivation: sqrt((frozen first bounce apex center z 0.2297635655733633 - sphere radius0.11)/(release center z1.2 - radius0.11))

limitations: MuJoCo solref/solimp and condim have no exact PhysX mapping; restitution is an explicit uncalibrated input.
Plane collision uses the native USD Plane schema; runtime contact behavior must be verified.
Dynamic mesh colliders use PhysX convex hull cooking; MuJoCo mesh collision also uses convex hulls, but cooking algorithms differ.
Texture checker/skybox and MuJoCo reflectance are not transferred; compiled surface geometry and material colors are retained.
MuJoCo torsional/rolling friction and actuator/controller behavior are not reproduced by USD materials/drives.
Robot scene keeps source per-geom friction with max combine; ball-goal/robot sliding friction is 1.0 versus source priority-1 value 0.6. Full-scene material priority parity is unresolved.
robot_absent_limitations: MuJoCo solref/solimp and condim have no exact PhysX mapping; restitution is an explicit uncalibrated input.
Plane collision uses the native USD Plane schema; runtime contact behavior must be verified.
Dynamic mesh colliders use PhysX convex hull cooking; MuJoCo mesh collision also uses convex hulls, but cooking algorithms differ.
Texture checker/skybox and MuJoCo reflectance are not transferred; compiled surface geometry and material colors are retained.
MuJoCo torsional/rolling friction and actuator/controller behavior are not reproduced by USD materials/drives.
Robot-absent materials bake the source ball priority-1 sliding friction 0.6 into every collider, matching ball-ground/frame coefficients only.
